name: Tarnowskie Góry Lead-Silver-Zinc Mine and its Underground Water Management System
description: In Tarnowskie Góry, in Upper Silesia, southern Poland, a maze of old mine tunnels lies beneath the town, worked for lead, silver and zinc. Visitors can descend into the galleries and the Black Trout Adit, a drainage tunnel that is often explored by boat. Above ground, the old shaft sites, waste heaps and a 19th-century steam pumping station show how miners spent three centuries fighting floodwater.
